ce_consent_disclaimer.label:
Formiler Consentemen Medikal
Obzektif : Sa formiler la se pou gagne consenteman tou banne patien ki vine faire zot
examiner ek recevoir traitement cot PILS a traver nou l'ekip medical. Tou banne informasion
personnel ek médical bane patien pou res confidensiel.

Consiltasion : Dan consiltasion la pou ena banne test sanguin et le zot test couma : VIH,
VHC, VHB, Syphilis, grossesse, créatinémie, TPHA, VDRL, GONO, Chlamydiae ek ene
frotti cervical

Examination : examen genital et/ ou anal si necessaire

Informasion lor patient :

Date : [consent_date]
Moi, (nom complet patien) [client_first_name] [client_last_name]
(mo date de naissance) [dob]
(ek mo nimero telephone) [phone_primary],

mone donne volontairement banne informasion vrai ek fiable,
ek mo comprends parfaitement obzektif sa consiltasion la et en quoi li consister. Dokter ek/ou
infirmier fine explik moi kouma consiltasion la pou passer et ine reponne a tou mo banne
kestions. Mo accepter fournir rezilta banne tests à PILS et ine explik moi ki tou mo banne
donnés pou reste confidensiel. Ine fine aussi explik moi conteni sa formiler la dans ene langaz
simple et ki mo compren.

ia_notes_intro.label: This assessment is intended to guide a conversation and identify areas where the beneficiary may need assistance in prioritizing/accessing services and reducing HIV/STI-related risk. Information is confidential. Review periodically as needs may change.

ia_identity_notes.label: How does the beneficiary identify? Consider: gay, bisexual, straight, trans, other.

ia_living_notes.label: Current living situation. Consider: rent/own, workplace, homelessness now or in last 6 months, alone/with someone; if with someone, relationship stability and duration.

ia_sexual_notes.label: Current partner(s)/client load. Consider partner gender, HIV status of regular partner, number of partners/clients, condom use with regular partner and with clients (sometimes/always/never).

ia_financial_notes.label: Employment/earning status and stability; other support/income; effect on lifestyle and health, ability to obtain/maintain medical care, and survival sex/exchange of sex for drugs, money, or accommodation.

ia_health_notes.label: Beneficiary’s general health status and needs. Consider self-rating (excellent/good/fair/poor), chronic conditions, substance use disorder/dependence, mental health, current health-care use/provider, where care is sought when ill, payment/coverage, and additional needs such as dental, vision, nutrition and fitness.
